title: Ceded lands; vacancy; development.
bodyText: No housing projects developed or constructed pursuant to this part shall be developed or constructed on ceded land that is vacant on or after January 1, 2022.
bodyHtml: §356D-11.2  Ceded lands; vacancy; development.  No housing projects developed or constructed pursuant to this part shall be developed or constructed on ceded land that is vacant on or after January 1, 2022. [L 2022, c 251, §1; am L 2025, c 89, §5]
